svg.title: Good Shepherd
svg.desc: The Good Shepherd of the Catacombs of Domitilla (Vatican Museums), traced from the photograph "Marble statue of The Good Shepherd from the Catacombs of Domitilla, Vatican Museums" by Carole Raddato (https://www.flickr.com/photos/carolemage/32143459745), CC BY-SA 2.0.
